name: list_voices
description: List available voices for speech and voice tools. Returns built-in preset voices plus the user's own custom voices. Each voice has a voice_id and a voice_type ('preset' or 'element'); pass that exact pair to the audio models (via generate_audio — seed_audio or text2speech_v2) and to the voice_change tool to select the speaking voice. Use the preview_url to hear a sample. Paginate with the returned next_cursor.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (next_cursor from a previous list_voices result).

voice_id.description: Pass as voice_id to generate_audio (seed_audio / text2speech_v2) / voice_change.

gender.description: Voice gender if known, else null.

logo_url.description: Voice logo/orb image URL for display.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as cursor to fetch the next page.

error.description: Error message if voices could not be fetched.

request_id.description: MCP server HTTP request ID for support/debugging. If present, show it to the user.
